messages.text: Im interesting on buying a bitcoin miner, however the match x m2 pro I bought from you guys never work. What can you do for me?

I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let's see if we can get that MatchX M2 Pro working.

A few things to narrow it down. The M2 Pro is a LoRaWAN / MXC miner, so "never worked" usually means one of three things: it never powered on, it powered on but never joined Wi-Fi, or it is online but never earned.

To start, one question: when you plug it in, do you get any LED on the unit at all, and if so what colour and is it steady or blinking?
